title: On this day: mastering mass and energy
note: Every event has a source that states the exact day; see 'dropped' for candidates left out. 'reserve' holds verified events trimmed only to keep each month at 15 or fewer.

events.title: Luna 1 becomes the first craft to reach escape velocity
events.why: The first spacecraft to reach escape velocity and leave Earth's gravity, ending up in orbit around the Sun.

events.title: Tejas light combat aircraft first flight
events.why: First flight of India's indigenous light combat aircraft, with a fly-by-wire system that keeps an unstable airframe under control.

events.title: James Watt's separate-condenser patent granted
events.why: Condensing steam outside the cylinder kept it hot, cutting fuel use sharply: the first big step in converting heat into work efficiently.

events.title: GSLV-D5 flies India's own cryogenic upper stage
events.why: India's first successful flight of its own cryogenic stage, burning liquid hydrogen kept at about −253 °C.

events.title: Aditya-L1 enters halo orbit around L1
events.why: India's solar observatory was steered into a halo orbit around Sun–Earth L1, a point where gravity and orbital motion balance.

events.title: Blanchard and Jeffries cross the English Channel by balloon
events.why: A hydrogen balloon carried two people across open sea, showing a gas lighter than air could move people between countries.

events.title: Spindletop gusher opens the Texas oil age
events.why: A gusher that flowed about 100,000 barrels a day made oil cheap enough to burn as fuel, starting the petroleum age.
events.note: The TSHA source was intermittently down when checked; the date matches the Texas State Library and Texas Historical Commission.

events.title: First insulin injection, Toronto
events.why: First use of pancreatic extract on a diabetic patient; Collip's purified extract on 23 January then brought his blood sugar down, regulating a living system from outside.
events.note: A purer extract given from 23 January produced the clear clinical response.

events.title: SpaDeX: India's first docking in orbit
events.why: Two Indian satellites found each other and docked in orbit, making India the fourth country to dock spacecraft.

events.title: USS Nautilus: 'Underway on nuclear power'
events.why: The first ship driven by a nuclear reactor: fission heat turned into motion, with no air needed for combustion.
events.source_name: US Naval History and Heritage Command

events.title: EAST tokamak holds high-confinement plasma 1,066 s
events.why: China's EAST tokamak held a high-confinement plasma for 1,066 seconds, a record for magnetically contained fusion fuel.

events.title: Trieste reaches the bottom of Challenger Deep
events.why: A steel sphere held two people at about 11 km depth, where the water pushes back with over a thousand atmospheres of pressure.

events.title: CERN announces the W boson
events.why: CERN announced the W boson, a carrier of the weak force, by colliding protons and antiprotons hard enough to create it.

events.title: Carl Benz files the motor-car patent
events.why: The patent for a vehicle powered by a gas engine, widely called the motor car's birth certificate: a small engine turning heat into wheeled motion.

events.title: Explorer 1, first US satellite, reaches orbit
events.why: America's first satellite; its radiation counter revealed the Van Allen belts of charged particles trapped by Earth's magnetic field.
events.note: Launched late on 31 January local time (1 February UTC).

events.title: India's first electric train, Bombay VT–Kurla
events.why: India's first electric train ran between Bombay VT and Kurla, replacing steam with power drawn from wires.

events.title: Luna 9 makes the first soft landing on the Moon
events.why: The first controlled landing on another world, and the first pictures from the Moon's surface.

events.title: First patient treated with purified penicillin, Oxford
events.why: The first patient given purified penicillin improved within days, but died when the small supply ran out. It showed the drug worked in people.
events.source_name: Oxford Health Histories, University of Oxford

events.title: WEST tokamak holds plasma for 1,337 s
events.why: France's WEST tokamak held a plasma for 1,337 seconds, beating the duration record set by China's EAST three weeks earlier.

events.title: RHIC reports 4 trillion degrees, hottest matter made
events.why: Brookhaven reported a quark–gluon plasma at about 4 trillion °C, the hottest matter ever made in a laboratory.

events.title: PSLV-C37 places 104 satellites in one launch
events.why: One PSLV placed 104 satellites into orbit, each released in sequence to keep them apart. A record at the time.

events.title: Chadwick reports the neutron
events.why: Chadwick's letter to Nature, dated this day, reported the neutron: the neutral particle that later made chain reactions possible.
events.note: The letter is dated 17 February; Nature printed it on 27 February 1932.

events.title: Perseverance lands on Mars
events.why: A rover landed by sky crane in Jezero Crater, steering itself away from hazards during the descent.

events.title: John Glenn orbits Earth
events.why: The first American to orbit Earth flew three orbits and came home through re-entry heat despite a warning that his heat shield might be loose.

events.title: Trevithick's locomotive makes the first railway steam journey
events.why: A high-pressure steam locomotive hauled iron and passengers on rails in Wales, the first railway journey by steam.

events.title: Wöhler synthesises urea from inorganic salts
events.why: Wöhler made urea, a compound from living bodies, out of inorganic salts: chemistry, not a 'vital force', builds life's molecules.

events.title: Hall makes aluminium by electrolysis
events.why: Charles Martin Hall got aluminium out of its oxide by passing a current through molten cryolite, turning a precious metal into a cheap one.

events.title: Rudolf Diesel's engine patent granted
events.why: Diesel's patent for compression ignition: squeezing air until it is hot enough to ignite fuel, for higher efficiency.

events.title: C. V. Raman discovers the Raman effect
events.why: Raman saw light scattered by molecules change colour, a fingerprint of how they vibrate. India marks the day as National Science Day.

events.title: Carothers' team first makes nylon 6,6
events.why: DuPont's lab first made nylon 6,6, the first fully synthetic fibre: chemistry used to design matter to order.
events.note: Gerard Berchet made the first sample in Carothers' group.

events.title: Becquerel finds uranium's rays fog plates
events.why: Uranium salts fogged a photographic plate with no sunlight involved, revealing radioactivity: energy released from inside atoms.

events.title: Venera 3 becomes the first craft to reach another planet
events.why: The first human-made object to reach another planet, crashing into Venus.

events.title: Lucky Lady II completes the first non-stop round-the-world flight
events.why: A B-50 flew round the world non-stop in about 94 hours, refuelled in the air four times.
events.source_name: US Air Force Historical Support Division

events.title: Concorde first flight
events.why: First flight of the Anglo-French supersonic airliner, built to cruise at about twice the speed of sound.

events.title: Pioneer 10 launches toward Jupiter and beyond
events.why: The first probe sent through the asteroid belt and past Jupiter, on a path out of the Solar System.
events.note: Launched on 2 March local time (3 March UTC).

events.title: Aspirin registered as a trademark
events.why: Bayer's synthesised acetylsalicylic acid became a registered trademark, a stable, mass-made drug derived from willow bark chemistry.

events.title: First US patient saved by penicillin
events.why: A dying patient in Connecticut recovered after penicillin, the first US civilian life saved by the drug.

events.title: Goddard flies the first liquid-fuel rocket
events.why: Goddard's 2.5-second flight in Auburn, Massachusetts, proved liquid propellants could drive a rocket.

events.title: Vanguard 1, first solar-powered satellite
events.why: The first satellite powered by solar cells; it still orbits and is the oldest human object in space.

events.title: Leonov makes the first spacewalk
events.why: Alexei Leonov spent about 12 minutes outside Voskhod 2, a pressure suit holding his body's atmosphere in vacuum.

events.title: MESSENGER enters orbit around Mercury
events.why: The first spacecraft to orbit Mercury, steered close to the Sun with a sunshade facing temperatures above 300 °C.
events.note: Orbit insertion 18 March UTC (17 March US Eastern time).

events.title: Volta describes the electric pile
events.why: Volta's letter to the Royal Society, dated this day, described the pile: the first steady source of electric current, made from chemistry.

events.title: LHC's first 7 TeV collisions
events.why: The LHC collided protons at 7 TeV, a world record energy that opened its physics programme.

events.title: RLV-LEX autonomous landing of a winged body
events.why: ISRO's winged reusable launch vehicle prototype was dropped from a helicopter and landed itself on a runway.

events.title: Rakesh Sharma flies to space
events.why: Rakesh Sharma launched on Soyuz T-11, the first Indian in space.

events.title: TGV sets the 574.8 km/h rail record
events.why: A modified TGV reached 574.8 km/h, the world speed record for a train on conventional rails.

events.title: Plunkett finds Teflon
events.why: Plunkett found that a cylinder of tetrafluoroethylene gas had polymerised into a slippery, inert solid: PTFE.

events.title: Kamerlingh Onnes sees mercury lose resistance
events.why: Kamerlingh Onnes's notebook records mercury's resistance vanishing near 4 K: electricity flowing with no loss.

events.title: Salk polio vaccine declared safe and effective
events.why: The Francis field trial announced the Salk polio vaccine safe and effective: immunity trained at national scale.
events.source_name: University of Michigan School of Public Health

events.title: Yuri Gagarin, first human in orbit
events.why: Yuri Gagarin made one orbit of Earth in Vostok 1, the first human in space.

events.title: First Space Shuttle launch
events.why: First flight of the Space Shuttle, the first reusable crewed orbital spacecraft.

events.title: Cockcroft and Walton split the atom with an accelerator
events.why: Cockcroft and Walton split lithium nuclei with accelerated protons, the first nuclear transmutation by a machine.

events.title: India's first passenger train, Bori Bunder–Thane
events.why: India's first passenger train ran 34 km from Bori Bunder to Thane, hauled by steam.
events.source_name: Comptroller and Auditor General of India (Railways)

events.title: Aryabhata, India's first satellite
events.why: India's first satellite, built by ISRO and launched on a Soviet rocket.

events.title: Ingenuity: first powered flight on another planet
events.why: A 1.8 kg helicopter lifted off in Mars's thin atmosphere, about 1% as dense as Earth's: the first powered flight on another planet.

events.title: SCMaglev reaches 603 km/h
events.why: A Japanese superconducting maglev reached 603 km/h, floating on magnetic fields: the fastest train run on record.

events.title: DNA double helix published
events.why: Watson and Crick's double helix (with Franklin's and Wilkins's X-ray data) showed how living systems store and copy information.

events.title: Bell Labs unveils the silicon solar cell
events.why: Bell Labs showed a silicon solar cell turning about 6% of sunlight into electricity, the start of practical photovoltaics.

events.title: De Havilland Comet opens jet airliner service
events.why: BOAC's de Havilland Comet flew the world's first scheduled jet airliner service, London to Johannesburg.

events.title: Alan Shepard's Freedom 7
events.why: Alan Shepard's suborbital Freedom 7 flight, the first American in space.

events.title: Gorrie patents mechanical ice-making
events.why: John Gorrie's US patent for a machine that made ice by expanding compressed air, a forerunner of mechanical refrigeration.

events.title: World Health Assembly declares smallpox eradicated
events.why: The World Health Assembly declared smallpox eradicated, the first human disease ended by deliberate effort.

events.title: Golden spike joins the first US transcontinental railroad
events.why: At Promontory Summit, a golden spike completed the first US transcontinental railroad.

events.title: Dewar liquefies hydrogen
events.why: James Dewar liquefied hydrogen at about 20 K, using vacuum-insulated flasks he had invented to hold the cold.
events.source_name: Dewar, Proceedings of the Royal Society (1898)

events.title: Pokhran-II tests; now National Technology Day
events.why: India's Pokhran-II nuclear tests; 11 May is now marked as National Technology Day.
events.note: Weapons tests are included for the energy milestone they mark, not as celebration.

events.title: Jenner vaccinates James Phipps
events.why: Edward Jenner inoculated James Phipps with cowpox and showed it protected against smallpox, the first vaccination.
events.source_name: History of Vaccines (College of Physicians of Philadelphia)

events.title: Tesla presents the AC induction motor
events.why: Tesla's lecture to the AIEE set out the polyphase AC motor, driven by a rotating magnetic field.
events.source_name: Tesla's AIEE lecture text, via Tesla Universe

events.title: Maiman's ruby laser fires
events.why: Theodore Maiman's ruby laser fired at Hughes Research Labs, the first time light was made coherent and aimed this tightly.

events.title: Pokhran-I, India's first nuclear test
events.why: India's first nuclear test, an underground implosion device at Pokhran: fission energy released on purpose, announced as a peaceful nuclear explosion.
events.source_name: US Office of the Historian (embassy telegram, 18 May 1974)
events.note: Weapons tests are included for the energy milestone they mark, not as celebration.

events.title: Lindbergh takes off on the first solo non-stop transatlantic flight
events.why: Lindbergh left New York alone and landed near Paris 33.5 hours later: one engine and a fuel load moving a person across an ocean.
events.source_name: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum
events.note: He landed at Le Bourget on the night of 21 May, Paris time.

events.title: Dragon becomes first commercial craft at the ISS
events.why: SpaceX's Dragon was berthed at the ISS, the first commercial spacecraft to visit the station.

events.title: Crew Dragon Demo-2 launches
events.why: The first crewed orbital launch from the US since 2011, and the first by a commercially built spacecraft.

events.title: Montgolfiers' public hot-air balloon demonstration
events.why: In Annonay, the Montgolfier brothers flew an uncrewed hot-air balloon in public: heated air lifting a load.

events.title: S. N. Bose writes to Einstein
events.why: S. N. Bose sent Einstein his new way of counting photons, the statistics that predict Bose–Einstein condensates.

events.title: First Bose–Einstein condensate, JILA
events.why: At JILA, Cornell and Wieman cooled rubidium atoms to about 170 nK and made the first Bose–Einstein condensate.

events.title: GSLV Mk III's first orbital flight
events.why: GSLV Mk III (now LVM3) reached orbit on its first developmental flight, India's heaviest launcher.

events.title: Torricelli's letter describes the mercury barometer and a vacuum
events.why: Torricelli's letter, dated this day, described a column of mercury held up by air pressure, with an empty space above it: the barometer.

events.title: Gossamer Albatross: human-powered Channel crossing
events.why: Bryan Allen pedalled the Gossamer Albatross across the English Channel: human muscle power alone, in flight.

events.title: Alcock and Brown complete the first non-stop transatlantic flight
events.why: Alcock and Brown landed in Ireland after the first non-stop flight across the Atlantic, from Newfoundland.

events.title: Huygens patents the pendulum clock
events.why: Huygens patented the pendulum clock, regulating motion so accurately that timekeeping errors fell to seconds a day.

events.title: Tereshkova, first woman in space
events.why: Valentina Tereshkova orbited Earth 48 times in Vostok 6, the first woman in space.

events.title: Shubhanshu Shukla launches on Axiom-4
events.why: Shubhanshu Shukla launched on Axiom Mission 4 and became the first Indian aboard the International Space Station.

events.title: Turbinia's steam-turbine dash at Spithead
events.why: Parsons's Turbinia ran past the Fleet Review at Spithead, showing steam turbines could beat piston engines for speed.

events.title: Human genome working draft announced
events.why: A working draft of the human genome was announced, the full instruction set of a living system laid out.

events.title: Obninsk: first nuclear plant feeds a grid
events.why: The Obninsk plant near Moscow began supplying electricity to the grid, the first nuclear plant to do so.
events.note: IAEA material gives 26 or 27 June for grid connection; 27 June is the commonly cited date.

events.title: CRISPR-Cas9 programmable cutting published
events.why: Jinek, Doudna, Charpentier and colleagues showed Cas9 can be programmed to cut chosen DNA sequences.

events.title: Shivanasamudra hydro plant powers Kolar gold fields
events.why: One of Asia's first hydroelectric plants sent power about 150 km to the Kolar Gold Fields.

events.title: Haber demonstrates ammonia synthesis to BASF
events.why: Fritz Haber's tabletop apparatus made ammonia from air's nitrogen at high pressure, shown to BASF: the route to synthetic fertiliser.

events.title: Mallard sets the steam speed record
events.why: LNER A4 Mallard reached 126 mph, still the world speed record for a steam locomotive.
events.note: The 126 mph (203 km/h) peak was held only briefly; Guinness lists the ratified figure as 201 km/h.

events.title: Larderello: first electricity from geothermal steam
events.why: Prince Piero Ginori Conti lit five light bulbs with a dynamo driven by natural steam: the first electricity from geothermal heat.

events.title: CERN announces a Higgs-like boson
events.why: ATLAS and CMS announced a new particle consistent with the Higgs boson, the field that gives fundamental particles their mass.

events.title: Kamerlingh Onnes liquefies helium
events.why: Kamerlingh Onnes liquefied helium at about 4 K, the last gas to give in and the route to ultra-low temperatures.
events.note: Date from Leiden University's account of Kamerlingh Onnes's lab; his Nobel lecture describes the same run.

events.title: CIRUS research reactor goes critical
events.why: The CIRUS research reactor at Trombay went critical, a core facility for India's nuclear programme.

events.title: Chandrayaan-3 launches on LVM3
events.why: LVM3 launched Chandrayaan-3 toward the Moon.

events.title: Trinity: first nuclear explosive test
events.why: The first nuclear explosive test, in New Mexico: the first large release of fission energy, at enormous human cost.
events.note: Weapons tests are included for the energy milestone they mark, not as celebration.

events.title: Carrier's first modern air-conditioning design
events.why: Willis Carrier's drawings for a Brooklyn printing plant controlled humidity and temperature together: modern air-conditioning.

events.title: SLV-3 puts Rohini in orbit
events.why: SLV-3 put the Rohini satellite into orbit, making India the sixth country to launch a satellite on its own rocket.

events.title: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon
events.why: Eagle landed on the Moon with Armstrong and Aldrin, steered by hand past a boulder field with seconds of fuel margin.

events.title: Ørsted publishes electromagnetism
events.why: Ørsted's pamphlet showed an electric current deflects a compass needle, linking electricity and magnetism.

events.title: Blériot flies across the English Channel
events.why: Louis Blériot flew across the English Channel in about 37 minutes, the first flight across a sea in a heavier-than-air craft.

events.title: Louise Brown, first IVF baby, born
events.why: Louise Brown was born, the first baby conceived by in-vitro fertilisation.

events.title: Solar Impulse 2 completes a solar-powered circumnavigation
events.why: A solar-powered aircraft finished a round-the-world flight with no fuel, flying through nights on stored battery energy.

events.title: Priestley isolates oxygen
events.why: Priestley heated mercuric oxide and collected a gas in which a candle burned brightly: oxygen.

events.title: Apsara, Asia's first research reactor, goes critical
events.why: Apsara at Trombay went critical, the first research reactor in Asia.

events.title: Curiosity's sky-crane landing on Mars
events.why: A sky crane lowered the car-sized rover onto Mars, an automated landing sequence that came to be called seven minutes of terror.
events.note: Landed 6 August UTC (5 August Pacific time).

events.title: Parker Solar Probe launches
events.why: Parker Solar Probe launched on a path to fly through the Sun's outer atmosphere.

events.title: Bessemer presents steel 'without fuel'
events.why: Bessemer's paper described blowing air through molten iron to burn out carbon, making cheap steel in minutes.
events.source_name: Grace's Guide to British Industrial History

events.title: Brearley casts the first stainless steel
events.why: Harry Brearley cast a chromium steel in Sheffield that resisted rust: the first stainless steel.
events.note: Brearley's first cast; the first commercial cast followed on 20 August 1913.

events.title: Perkins patents vapour-compression refrigeration
events.why: Jacob Perkins's British patent described a closed vapour-compression cycle, the principle inside most refrigerators.

events.title: Panama Canal opens
events.why: The canal opened, lifting ships 26 m over the isthmus through locks fed by Gatun Lake.

events.title: Cochin airport becomes fully solar powered
events.why: Cochin International Airport became the world's first airport run fully on solar power.

events.title: Chandrayaan-3 lands near the lunar south pole
events.why: Vikram landed near the lunar south pole, making India the fourth country to soft-land on the Moon. India marks the day as National Space Day.

events.title: Drake's well strikes oil, Titusville
events.why: Edwin Drake's well at Titusville struck oil at 69.5 feet, the start of the modern US oil industry.

events.title: Heinkel He 178, first jet-powered flight
events.why: The Heinkel He 178 made the first flight powered by a turbojet.
events.source_name: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum

events.title: ISRO flight-tests a scramjet engine
events.why: ISRO flew a scramjet engine that breathes air at hypersonic speed to burn its fuel.

events.title: Faraday discovers electromagnetic induction
events.why: Faraday's diary records current induced by a changing magnetic field, the principle behind every generator and transformer.

events.title: Aditya-L1 launches
events.why: PSLV-C57 launched Aditya-L1, India's first solar observatory in space.

events.title: Faraday's electromagnetic rotation
events.why: Faraday made a wire carrying a current rotate around a magnet: electricity turned into continuous motion.

events.title: Edison's Pearl Street station starts
events.why: Edison's Pearl Street station began supplying power to Lower Manhattan, the first central power station for incandescent lighting.

events.title: Voyager 1 launches
events.why: Launched to Jupiter and Saturn, it is now the most distant human-made object.

events.title: DRDO flies the HSTDV scramjet demonstrator
events.why: DRDO's hypersonic technology demonstrator flew under scramjet power at about Mach 6.

events.title: First industrial Haber–Bosch ammonia plant starts, Oppau
events.why: BASF's Oppau plant started making ammonia by the Haber–Bosch process at industrial scale.

events.title: LHC first beam
events.why: The first proton beam went round the 27 km LHC ring, steered by superconducting magnets at 1.9 K.

events.title: Luna 2 reaches the Moon's surface
events.why: The first human-made object to reach the Moon, aimed across about 380,000 km of space.
events.note: Impact was 21:02 UTC on 13 September, already 14 September in Moscow.

events.title: Liverpool and Manchester Railway opens
events.why: The first intercity railway ran entirely on steam power, between Liverpool and Manchester.

events.title: Puy-de-Dôme: air pressure falls with height
events.why: Florin Périer carried Pascal's mercury tube up the Puy de Dôme and saw it fall, showing air has weight that thins with height.

events.title: Mangalyaan enters Mars orbit on the first try
events.why: Mangalyaan entered Mars orbit, making India the first nation to succeed on its first attempt.

events.title: Stockton and Darlington Railway opens
events.why: The first public railway to use steam locomotives opened, with Locomotion No. 1 hauling coal and passengers.

events.title: Falcon 1 reaches orbit
events.why: The first privately developed liquid-fuelled rocket to reach Earth orbit.

events.title: Vulcan Street: first hydroelectric central station
events.why: The Vulcan Street Plant in Appleton was the first hydroelectric central station serving private and commercial customers.

events.title: Hoover Dam dedicated
events.why: Hoover Dam was dedicated, holding back the Colorado River and turning its fall into electricity.

events.title: Tokaido Shinkansen opens
events.why: The Tokaido Shinkansen opened between Tokyo and Osaka, the first high-speed rail line.

events.title: X-15 reaches Mach 6.7
events.why: Pete Knight flew the X-15 to Mach 6.7, the fastest crewed winged flight, which scorched the aircraft's heat-resistant coating.

events.title: Sputnik 1, first artificial satellite
events.why: Sputnik 1 reached orbit, the first artificial satellite: a rocket gave it enough speed to keep falling around Earth.

events.title: First implanted pacemaker
events.why: Arne Larsson received the first implanted pacemaker in Stockholm, an electrical pulse regulating a heartbeat.

events.title: Super Heavy booster caught by the launch tower
events.why: SpaceX caught a returning Super Heavy booster with the arms of its launch tower.

events.title: Bell X-1 breaks the sound barrier
events.why: Chuck Yeager flew the rocket-powered Bell X-1 faster than sound, the first time in level flight.
events.source_name: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum

events.title: PSLV's first successful flight
events.why: PSLV's first successful flight; it became India's workhorse launcher.

events.title: Ether anaesthesia demonstrated, Boston
events.why: At Massachusetts General Hospital, William Morton's ether let surgery proceed without pain. The date is remembered as Ether Day.

events.title: Calder Hall opens
events.why: Calder Hall was opened, the first nuclear power station to deliver electricity at commercial scale.

events.title: Smith–Putnam turbine feeds the grid
events.why: A 1.25 MW wind turbine on Grandpa's Knob, Vermont, fed a utility grid, the first megawatt-scale wind generator.

events.title: Gaganyaan TV-D1 crew-escape test
events.why: ISRO's test vehicle fired the Gaganyaan crew escape system and parachuted the crew module into the sea.

events.title: Bhakra Dam dedicated
events.why: Bhakra Dam was dedicated to the nation, holding back the Sutlej for irrigation and hydropower.

events.title: Chandrayaan-1 launches
events.why: PSLV-C11 launched Chandrayaan-1, India's first mission to the Moon.

events.title: Kolkata Metro, India's first metro, opens
events.why: Kolkata Metro opened its first section, India's first underground railway.

events.title: Tarapur, India's first nuclear power station, enters service
events.why: Tarapur Atomic Power Station began commercial operation, India's first nuclear power station.

events.title: Mangalyaan launches
events.why: PSLV-C25 launched the Mars Orbiter Mission, which then coasted for about ten months on a transfer orbit timed to meet Mars.

events.title: Röntgen discovers X-rays
events.why: Röntgen found that rays from a cathode-ray tube passed through matter and lit up a screen: X-rays.

events.title: Saturn V's first flight
events.why: First flight of the Saturn V, the most powerful rocket flown at the time, launched uncrewed.

events.title: JET makes the first controlled D–T fusion power
events.why: JET ran the first controlled fusion experiment with a deuterium–tritium fuel mix, making about 1.7 MW of fusion power.

events.title: Philae lands on a comet
events.why: The Philae lander touched down on comet 67P, the first landing on a comet.

events.title: Moon Impact Probe reaches the lunar surface
events.why: Chandrayaan-1's Moon Impact Probe reached the lunar surface, putting the Indian flag on the Moon.

events.title: Niagara power reaches Buffalo
events.why: Electricity from Niagara Falls reached Buffalo about 40 km away, proving long-distance AC transmission.
events.note: Current reached Buffalo just after midnight on 16 November (dispatch dated 15 November).

events.title: X-43A scramjet reaches Mach 9.6
events.why: NASA's X-43A flew at about Mach 9.6 on scramjet power, a record for an air-breathing aircraft.

events.title: Suez Canal opens
events.why: The Suez Canal opened, joining the Mediterranean and Red Sea without locks.

events.title: ALPHA traps antihydrogen atoms
events.why: CERN's ALPHA experiment trapped antihydrogen atoms in a magnetic bottle, containing antimatter that would vanish on touching matter.

events.title: Zarya, first ISS module, launches
events.why: Zarya, the first module of the International Space Station, launched.

events.title: First crewed free flight, hot-air balloon
events.why: Pilâtre de Rozier and the Marquis d'Arlandes made the first crewed free flight, in a Montgolfier hot-air balloon over Paris.

events.title: First rocket launch from Thumba
events.why: A Nike-Apache sounding rocket lifted off from Thumba near Thiruvananthapuram, the start of India's space programme.

events.title: Rance tidal power station opens
events.why: The Rance tidal power station in Brittany opened, the first large plant generating electricity from the tides.

events.title: Chicago Pile-1: first self-sustaining chain reaction
events.why: Under Chicago's Stagg Field, Fermi's team achieved the first self-sustaining nuclear chain reaction and held it under control with cadmium rods.

events.title: First human heart transplant
events.why: Christiaan Barnard's team transplanted a human heart at Groote Schuur Hospital, Cape Town.

events.title: NIF achieves fusion ignition
events.why: Lawrence Livermore's lasers produced more fusion energy (3.15 MJ) than they delivered to the target (2.05 MJ): ignition.

events.title: Venera 7: first data from another planet's surface
events.why: Venera 7 sent data from Venus's surface, about 475 °C under crushing pressure: the first transmission from another planet's surface.

events.title: Bell Labs point-contact transistor works
events.why: Bardeen and Brattain's point-contact transistor amplified a signal at Bell Labs, starting solid-state control of electric current.

events.title: GE makes synthetic diamond
events.why: GE's Tracy Hall turned carbon into diamond at high pressure and temperature, repeatably.
events.note: ASEA in Sweden made diamonds in 1953 but did not publish; GE's was the first reproducible, announced result.

events.title: Wright brothers' first powered flights
events.why: Orville and Wilbur Wright made four controlled, powered flights at Kitty Hawk, the longest lasting 59 seconds.
events.source_name: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum

events.title: LVM3-X/CARE: crew-module re-entry test
events.why: LVM3-X carried an uncrewed crew-module prototype that came back through re-entry heat and splashed down in the Bay of Bengal.

events.title: EBR-I: first electricity from nuclear power
events.why: EBR-I in Idaho lit four light bulbs with electricity from nuclear fission, a first.

events.title: First orbital-class booster lands upright
events.why: A Falcon 9 first stage came back after an orbital launch and landed upright at Cape Canaveral.
events.note: Landing on 21 December local time in Florida.

events.title: JET produces 59 MJ fusion energy
events.why: JET produced 59 megajoules of fusion energy in a five-second pulse, a world record at the time.

events.title: First successful kidney transplant
events.why: Joseph Murray's team in Boston transplanted a kidney between identical twins, the first long-term success.

events.title: Apollo 8 orbits the Moon
events.why: Apollo 8 entered lunar orbit, the first crew to leave Earth's gravity well and see Earthrise.

events.title: Parker Solar Probe's record closest pass to the Sun
events.why: Parker Solar Probe passed about 6.1 million km from the Sun's surface at about 692,000 km/h, the fastest and closest pass of any spacecraft.

events.title: The Curies announce radium
events.why: Marie and Pierre Curie, with Gustave Bémont, announced radium to the Académie des Sciences.

reserve.title: Huygens probe lands on Titan
reserve.why: The first landing in the outer Solar System: a probe parachuted through Titan's thick atmosphere and sent data from the surface.

reserve.title: New Horizons launches at record speed
reserve.why: Launched faster than any spacecraft before it, it went on to fly past Pluto in 2015.

reserve.title: Concorde begins supersonic passenger service
reserve.why: Scheduled passenger flights at twice the speed of sound began: heat and drag managed well enough to sell as a service.

reserve.title: SRE-1 capsule survives re-entry and is recovered
reserve.why: ISRO's capsule came back through the atmosphere behind a heat shield and was recovered from the Bay of Bengal, India's first return from orbit.

reserve.title: MAIUS-1 makes the first Bose–Einstein condensate in space
reserve.why: A sounding rocket made the first Bose–Einstein condensate in space, cooling atoms to within a hair of absolute zero in free fall.

reserve.title: Edison's incandescent-lamp patent granted
reserve.why: US patent 223,898 for a carbon filament in an evacuated bulb: electric current turned into steady, controllable light.

reserve.title: First untethered spacewalk with a jet backpack
reserve.why: Bruce McCandless flew free of the Shuttle on a nitrogen-jet backpack, steering his own motion in orbit with no tether.

reserve.title: Boeing 747 first flight
reserve.why: First flight of the jumbo jet, which made long-distance flying cheap enough for mass travel.

reserve.title: Dolly the sheep announced
reserve.why: Roslin Institute announced a sheep cloned from an adult cell, showing a specialised cell's DNA can be reprogrammed.

reserve.title: Héroult patents aluminium electrolysis
reserve.why: Paul Héroult patented the same electrolytic route to aluminium in France as Hall did in America.

reserve.title: SpaceShipOne makes the first private crewed spaceflight
reserve.why: Mike Melvill flew SpaceShipOne above 100 km, the first privately funded crewed spaceflight.
reserve.source_name: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum

reserve.title: Mariner 4 flies past Mars
reserve.why: The first close flyby of Mars, returning the first pictures of another planet from space.
reserve.note: Closest approach was on 15 July UTC.

reserve.title: Viking 1 lands on Mars
reserve.why: The first fully successful Mars landing; Viking 1 worked on the surface for over six years.

reserve.title: NISAR launches on GSLV-F16
reserve.why: GSLV-F16 launched NISAR, the NASA–ISRO radar satellite that maps how Earth's surface moves.

reserve.title: Ford Model T goes on sale
reserve.why: Ford began selling the Model T, the car that put motor transport within reach of ordinary buyers.

reserve.title: ThrustSSC: first supersonic land-speed record
reserve.why: Andy Green drove ThrustSSC past the speed of sound on land, at an average of 1,227.985 km/h.

reserve.title: Shippingport reaches full power
reserve.why: Shippingport, Pennsylvania, reached full power, the first full-scale US nuclear plant built for electricity alone.

reserve.title: JWST launches
reserve.why: Ariane 5 launched the James Webb Space Telescope, whose sunshield keeps its mirror below about −223 °C.

dropped: Davy isolates potassium, 6 Oct 1807: the day is widely repeated but not shown in his notebook or the Bakerian lecture we could check.
Edison's carbon-filament lamp test, 22 Oct 1879: sources give 21 or 22 October for the 13.5-hour burn.
Voyager 1 enters interstellar space, 25 Aug 2012: NASA says 'on or about' that date, reconstructed from later data.
Savery's steam-pump patent, 25 Jul 1698: an Old Style (Julian) date, so the modern calendar day is ambiguous.
Sidrapong hydro plant, Darjeeling, 10 Nov 1897: only weak secondary sources for the day.
Fleming notices penicillin, 28 Sep 1928: the day comes from later recollection, not a dated record.
Cailletet and Pictet liquefy oxygen, Dec 1877: accounts differ on which day counts (experiment vs announcement).
Lauffen–Frankfurt three-phase transmission, 1891: accounts differ on the first day power reached Frankfurt.
Wróblewski and Olszewski liquefy oxygen, 5 Apr 1883: no institutional source found in this pass that states the day.
Otto's four-stroke engine first runs, 9 May 1876: the day could not be confirmed from a reliable source.
Charles and Robert's hydrogen balloon, 1 Dec 1783: not verified against a reliable source in this pass.
Ford's moving assembly line, 1 Dec 1913: Ford sources give different start days for different lines.
Baekeland's Bakelite patent, 7 Dec 1909: the grant date could not be confirmed from the patent record in this pass.
Southern grid synchronised with the national grid, 31 Dec 2013: no official source confirmed the exact day in this pass.
Mission Shakti ASAT test, 27 Mar 2019: dropped on scope (a weapons demonstration, not a mass/energy first).
Dolly the sheep born, 5 Jul 1996: duplicate of the 22 Feb 1997 announcement (kept that one in reserve).
Collip's purified insulin, 23 Jan 1922: merged into the 11 Jan 1922 insulin entry as a note.
